title: Advancing Soft X-ray Tomography: Enhancing Resolution, Speed, and Applications in Biomedical Research
content: Soft X-ray tomography (SXT) revolutionizes cellular imaging by enabling high-resolution, quantitative visualization of entire mammalian cells in their native state[1], [2]. Utilizing soft X-rays (284-543 eV), SXT provides unparalleled insights into cellular protein content without chemical fixation or staining. This unique capability has propelled SXT to the forefront of various applications, from bacterial and eukaryotic cell phenotyping to investigating complex cell interactions with nanoparticles, parasites, and viruses[3].
